flows.ai_operations: Dashboard AI jobs are read-only except cancel. Metrics aggregates job statuses/characters and feedback count/average rating. Result resources are read-only.
flows.authentication: There is no separate dashboard login/session endpoint. The dashboard uses the shared JWT endpoints, then GET /api/v1/admin/me/ to obtain active roles, permission codes and allowed sections.
flows.rbac: Most /api/v1/admin/ operations require IsAdminDashboardUser plus action-specific HasAdminPermission. /api/v1/ai/service-health/ instead uses Django IsAdminUser.
flows.support: Support ticket updates and messages require support.manage; reads require support.view. Non-internal admin replies set ticket status to waiting_user.

missing_expected_capabilities.backend_changes_required: Add RBAC-protected project serializer, filters and audit logging.
missing_expected_capabilities.why: Projects are mobile owner-scoped only; no /api/v1/admin/projects/ route exists.

missing_expected_capabilities.backend_changes_required: Persist typed telemetry fields, define retention/access controls, filters and aggregation.
missing_expected_capabilities.desired_capability: Structured AI provider/model/latency/token/cost and prompt-version analytics
missing_expected_capabilities.why: AIJob exposes service_metadata, quality_metrics and security_flags JSON but no stable structured fields, filters or cost aggregation API.

missing_expected_capabilities.backend_changes_required: Expose only approved telemetry snapshots and add indexed server-side filters/aggregates.
missing_expected_capabilities.desired_capability: Feedback filters and reports by character, provider, model, date, feedback type and status
missing_expected_capabilities.why: Admin AI feedback currently filters only rating and training_consent; it has no report aggregate endpoint.

missing_expected_capabilities.backend_changes_required: Define flag taxonomy, indexes, RBAC permissions and audit trail for disposition actions.
missing_expected_capabilities.desired_capability: Security-flagged AI-job filtering and investigation workflow
missing_expected_capabilities.why: AIJob serializes security_flags but AdminAIJobViewSet has no security flag filter or moderation action.

missing_expected_capabilities.backend_changes_required: Add RBAC rules, idempotency and audit logging; avoid arbitrary client-driven notification delivery.
missing_expected_capabilities.why: Notifications are only exposed through an owner-scoped mobile viewset.

validation_findings.contract_treatment: The generated projection overrides only this operation from the concrete view code.
validation_findings.evidence: DRF Spectacular selects AIJobSerializer for the feedback action, but AIJobViewSet.feedback explicitly validates and returns AIFeedbackSerializer with 201/200 and 409 branches.

validation_findings.contract_treatment: SourceCharacterResponse includes optional ai_job from concrete response-building code.
validation_findings.evidence: SourceCharacterResponseSerializer does not declare ai_job, while StudentSourceViewSet/CollectionViewSet _build_character_response adds AIJobSerializer(ai_job).data.

validation_findings.contract_treatment: The projection uses SourceProcessingQueuedResponse for the source process route.
validation_findings.evidence: The process action returns {message, source} with 202, while its decorator declares StudentSourceDetailSerializer.

validation_findings.contract_treatment: Every contract endpoint explicitly points to the exact renderer envelope.
